name: My Mother
overview: It is the story of the life of a middle-aged woman named Maral, who has gone through a life full of adventures and difficulties, and by relying on her willpower, she was able to bring herself and her family to peace and comfort. But the revelation of a secret robs him of this peace and causes his life to undergo great turmoil again. He realizes that all those who loved him and loved him have committed great crimes against him. So he decides to fight to get back everything that was wrongfully taken from him.
